Changing Gengar (Japanese: ゲンガー、化わる , Change) is the 575th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 27th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
The battle against Team Flare continues.
Gurkinn frees from his bindings and teaches him about Mega Evolution.
X battles Essentia while Korrina goes after Celosia.
Malva reveals herself and seals Diantha inside a .
Gurkinn gives X his , which is given the nickname Garma.
X Mega Evolves Garma into Mega Gengar and defeats Essentia's .
Korrina arrives at Celosia's location and begins attacking her.
